# ZedOps

> ZedOps is an AI platform for mechanical, electrical, and plumbing (MEP)
> construction execution. It connects schedule, field work, materials, cost
> control, and quality in one project record, so teams can see what needs
> attention and decide what to do next.

ZedOps is aimed at MEP contractors, general contractors, owners and developers,
project managers, and consultants running live construction work. Early access is
by application.

## Platform

- [Platform overview](https://zedops.com/solutions): scheduling, site execution, materials, quality and closeout in one place
- [Zed AI](https://zedops.com/zed-ai): AI over the same project record your crews use
